evals.expected_output: docs/lecture-01.md: full written lecture in the style of raw/examples (header block, numbered sections, Конец лекции 1), faithful to the lecture 1 transcript and handnotes, with SVG figures where they help; preview renders clean; report lists uncertain spots with timestamps.
assertions: Lecture file exists at docs/lecture-NN.md
Title is '# Лекция N. <Тема>'
Header block has «Необходимые знания» and «О чем лекция»
Sections are numbered 1, 2, 3, … (## N.)
Ends with «Конец лекции N.»
Preview check is clean (no KaTeX errors, missing images, stray $, Cyrillic in math)
Has at least one figure and every referenced image exists
Not marked as a draft (no «Черновик» banner)
Length is 25–70% of the transcript in Markdown chars (example ≈ 50%)
Report gives places to check with recording timestamps
Covers the lecture's main topics (Кронекер, Леви-Чивита, перестановочность сумм, немые индексы, симметрия, многоиндексные функции)
